en.title: This Zebra Is the Largest Wild Horse. Name It?
en.description: This is Grévy's zebra, the largest wild equine, weighing up to 450 kilograms. Its stripes are the narrowest and most closely set of any zebra, and its large, rounded ears give it a mule-like look.
